item.title: 1973 Ford F-250 Ranger XLT Camper Special 390 4-speed
item.description: This 1973 Ford F-250 Ranger XLT pickup was sold new from Western Slope Auto of Grand Junction, Colorado, and was acquired by the seller in 2025, reportedly from the original owner. The truck was ordered with a 390ci V8, a four-speed manual transmission, a limited-slip differential, and the Camper Special package, and the engine and transmission were overhauled in 2025. item.description: This 2008 Ford Mustang FR500S is a track-only model designed by Ford Racing and Miller Motorsports of Grantsville, Utah, and was reportedly used as a "media car" in promotional efforts for the Ford Racing Mustang Challenge spec racing series. item.title: Beck 550 Spyder Replica
item.description: The body and chassis of this Beck 550 Spyder were reportedly manufactured in 1984 and stored for many years before being acquired by the current owner in 2024. A 2.6L Subaru flat-four and four-speed manual transaxle with a hardened gear set have since been installed, and the car was painted silver with blue rear darts. item.title: 1987 Porsche 911 Carrera Targa G50
item.description: This 1987 Porsche 911 Carrera Targa was purchased by its current owner in 2017 and modified between 2019 and 2021. item.title: Enviate Hypercar Evo Hill-Climb Race Car
item.description: This Enviate Hypercar Evo was designed by the seller with the assistance of F1 engineer Sebastien Lamour and was built by the seller's company Affinity Aerodynamics, LLC primarily to compete in automotive hill climb race events. Driven by Paul Gerrard, who portrayed the "Stig" on the US version of Top Gear, it participated in the 99th and 100th runnings of the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb, finishing eighth-in-class in 2022. item.title: The Racing Relics Collection: No Reserve Racing & Track Bikes from 1600veloce
item.description: Our friends at 1600veloce have sold more four-wheeled vehicles on BaT than almost anyone, but ironically, their two collection sales have exclusively featured motorbikes. This is their second collection, and came out of the estate of a well-known collector on the East Coast. These seven racing and track-use bikes are being offered at no reserve, and all are untouched, non-running projects that were recently dusted off after over two decades in long-term storage.
